name: Murder Drones: RP | REMASTERED
desc:
Just like any other roleplay game, you have a map, some morphs, and a sprinkle of customization.

There is no other developer other than the owner.

Murder Drones is a computer-animated science fiction comedy-horror web series created by Liam Vickers and produced by Glitch Productions and funded by Screen Australia for GLITCH

! All Drinks are Soft Drinks such as Juice and Water !

Avatar Type
- R6

Supported Devices
- Mobile
- Tablet
- PC
- Console

scripts.title: ShrimpyHub
scripts.features: Custom Tools, Edit avatar of other players, and edit map. Uses webhook to avoid being spot by game's loggers.

comments.text: Can I have a tutorial on how to use it?

scripts.title: Admin Gui
scripts.features:
Makes an admin icon appear above your head. You can kick, prison, and ban people.
Uses webhook.

comments.text: all this does is log your username and userid and uses a discord bot to send it to a specific channel, useless script
